primary_metric: Mean squared error per value coordinate, averaged within independent trial
primary_comparison: development-selected ridge vs development-selected softmax per recall scenario
multiplicity: Holm across all reported recall model/scenario comparisons; Bonferroni paired t and paired percentile-bootstrap intervals
scope: Encoded-operator analysis only; no trained Mamba-3/Transformer/LM or TPU speed claim
holdout_policy: Independent named seed streams for development, evaluation and resampling. Select each method on development loss only. Retain every evaluation result. No sequential stopping.
